title: Measure and enforce Context Capsule route adherence
scope: Retain a bounded path-only manifest of successful context reads after routing without storing raw prompts, outputs, hidden reasoning, credentials, or temporary repository content.

Measure total context acquisition and route adherence separately from initial package size, Provider Tokens, latency, and command counts for single-repository and coordinator multi-repository recovery.

Prepare a generation-free successor protocol with a data-derived non-censoring single-repository ceiling, counterbalanced condition order, exact model configuration, and a separate approval gate before Provider generation.
acceptance_criteria: Successful read observations normalize to safe repository IDs and relative paths, remain bounded, and exclude raw commands and content; failed or disallowed reads cannot count as adherence.
The evaluator reports routed reads, permitted fallback reads, off-route reads, acquired bytes when known, and an explicit unknown state rather than inventing coverage.
Generation-free tests reproduce the WI-0139 overhead regression and censoring boundary, validate counterbalanced order and fixed limits, and prove no WI-0139 artifact changes.
No Provider generation occurs until a new immutable protocol and separate exact human approval record exist.
